comments.author: @manningbartlett522
comments.text:
Well I first read the books in the 80s and I just binge-watched this on Netflix. 

It has nothing to do with Douglas Adam's original stories, so if you expect that you'll be disappointed. And this interpretation of the character of Dirk Gently is only tenuously connected to the original.

But if you forget all that and just take this entirely on its own merits, it was brilliantly entertaining. Among my favourite shows of the year.
